freeTierSummary.en: Pay-as-you-go API with very low prices; new accounts may receive trial credits (see console). Current models: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (deepseek-flash) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro (deepseek-v4-pro), 1M context, thinking mode supported.
